source: ERFA, derived from the IAU SOFA algorithms
procedure: UTC instants were converted to two-part TT Julian dates, then evaluated with eraNut00b, eraObl06, eraPmat06, and eraPnm06a. Matrix rows are stored in row-major order as selected independent reference components.
instant: Four UTC instants from 1987 through 2050; see cases
timeScale: UTC input converted to TT before evaluating ERFA precession-nutation models
frame: IAU 2006 precession with IAU 2000A or 2000B nutation, as named by each stored quantity
accuracy: ERFA double-precision reference values. v3 intentionally remains on IAU 1976 mean obliquity and a four-term nutation approximation during M0, so its residual is bounded separately and is not the modern-model target.
